decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core offer, has its own page and fits the firm's push toward data-driven integration, so the option is cheap to keep and still promising.
The connectivity module is only mentioned on the website, but as a software add-on to the installed base it costs little to maintain while its value is still uncertain.
Billing software is further from the operational core and is only mentioned, but one year is too little evidence to abandon a low-cost software option.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed equipment and supports the service and maintenance business, so keeping this cheap option open is justified.
Resource management is close to the core and may be bundled with turnaround software, so its value is still uncertain and holding it costs little.
The safety alert service builds on the tower and traffic control offer, has long sales cycles, and needs more time before its value can be judged.
